title: Afterglow on the Orient
description: A woman in a white slip dress and black choker sits in a luxurious red velvet train seat, holding a cocktail and looking upward as glowing playing cards float through a beam of warm light from the window. Outside, a man in a suit stands by water at dusk with palm trees and a pink sky visible.
prompt: A beautiful woman in a white silk slip dress and black ribbon choker sits in a vintage luxury train car with red velvet seats and art deco wallpaper, holding a cocktail. Warm golden sunlight streams through the window, illuminating floating glowing playing cards drifting through the air. Outside the window is a tropical dusk scene with palm trees, water, and a man in a suit standing on the shore. Cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
